scenario: Employee reports VPN drops. Diagnostic finds an outdated client, employee updates it, diagnostic passes, employee confirms, incident resolved and closed.

input.user: Hi, my VPN keeps dropping every few minutes when I work from home. Ticket is INC-1001.

result.reply:
Thanks Priya. The diagnostic on your laptop (LT-4821) shows GlobalLink 5.1.2, which has a known bug that drops the tunnel every 5-10 minutes. Please:
1. Open Company Portal > Apps > GlobalLink VPN and click Install/Update.
2. Restart your laptop.
3. Reconnect and stay connected for about 10 minutes.
Let me know when that's done and I'll re-check.
